content.english: I shall prepare for the Sabbath with reason and knowledge!
The blessed light has arrived, the time of salvation.
As labors cease, our weariness disperses,
Greeting the Sabbath, I shall raise a shout:
Come in the glorious beauty, O Modest Bride,

content.hebrew: הִנֵּה אֲקַדֵּם לָךְ : עִם קוֹל תְּרוּעָה:
content.english: I shall greet you with a loud voice!
The Creator of the heavens is the Rock, who chose His nation,
Out of all creatures, to hallow His day.
The seventh day, the Sabbath, is rest in His image,

content.hebrew: אוֹת הִיא לְחִדּוּשׁ כֹּל : רֵאשִׁית תְּבוּאָה:
content.transliteration: Ot hi leḥiddush kol : reshit tevu’a.
content.english: It is a sign of all creation, the first fruit.
Come in the glorious beauty, O Modest Bride,

content.hebrew: הִנֵּה אֲקַדֵּם לָךְ : עִם קוֹל תְּרוּעָה:
content.english: I shall greet you with a loud voice!
Run, congregation, to worship your Creator!
Hallow it while it is still day; forget your grief!
Seek the strength of your King: He will destroy your oppressors.
He will illuminate His Presence for us to attain knowledge.
Come in the glorious beauty, O Modest Bride,

content.hebrew: הִנֵּה אֲקַדֵּם לָךְ : עִם קוֹל תְּרוּעָה:
content.english: I shall greet you with a loud voice!
God, in His majestic might, will make many miracles.
He will have mercy on His nation, which is suffering travails.
He will smite their enemies; He will forgive sins.
He will gather the dispersed to praise in awe.
Come in the glorious beauty, O Modest Bride,

content.hebrew: הִנֵּה אֲקַדֵּם לָךְ : עִם קוֹל תְּרוּעָה:
content.english: I shall greet you with a loud voice!
How sweet is my portion, awaiting my Messiah! :
My Righteous one, Rock of desire, receive my appeal:
Brace the weak ones; revive my spirit.
With whole hearts, we shall be worthy of reading Scripture.
Come in the glorious beauty, O Modest Bride,

content.hebrew: הִנֵּה אֲקַדֵּם לָךְ : עִם קוֹל תְּרוּעָה:
content.english: I shall greet you with a loud voice!
Amen! May it be His will; may He supply rest,
Both physical and spiritual, in the Garden.
Praised be the one who hallowed the blessed nation
To observe the Sabbath day, to see the redemption.
Come in the glorious beauty, O Modest Bride,

content.hebrew: הִנֵּה אֲקַדֵּם לָךְ : עִם קוֹל תְּרוּעָה:
content.english: I shall greet you with a loud voice!

content.hebrew: כַּכָּתוּב: לַֽיהֹוָ֥ה הַיְשׁוּעָ֑ה עַֽל־עַמְּךָ֖ בִרְכָתֶ֣ךָ סֶּֽלָה׃
content.english: As it is written: Deliverance is Adonai’s; Your blessing be upon Your people! Selah (Ps. 3:9).
